description: Main source file for clock control driver sample on MEC1501X/MEC172x SOC, including register access, clock source diagnostics, and logging.

methods.name: pcr_clock_regs
methods.description: Reads and logs PCR register states related to clock control, specific to MEC1501X SOC.

methods.name: vbat_clock_regs
methods.description: Reads and logs VBAT clock register states, specific to MEC1501X SOC.

methods.name: vbat_power_fail
methods.description: Checks and logs VBAT power-fail status, resets PFRS register.

methods.name: print_pll_clock_src
methods.description: Logs the PLL 32K clock source based on register value, for MEC172x SOC.

methods.name: print_periph_clock_src
methods.description: Logs peripheral 32K clock source based on register value, for MEC172x SOC.
